_note: THE INDUSTRY FAMILY, 5: THE WHOLE PIPELINE. Plan: home-office office/projects/delves/industry-family.md.
EVE's Producer career track in one job: the ore, the bench, the delivery. A craft whose ingredients include a
mid-rarity ore, then a deliver, at a site on a planet that carries it (MB56a's place.resource).

REWORKED 2026-11-10 (Eliza's 11-09 bring letter; OT-32 retired on his 10:07 ruling, 'limit the mission to a single planet where we know the resources are there'): the tungsten ingredient is ResInorgUncommonTungsten (a craft takes the Resource record, the lint says so); pinned to Bolivar I.

CARD 2026-11-10 (his 11-04 ruling, a posting by whoever set the job: no payer label, no payment line; his 11-10 'we still have all those X Contract things'). Was: "Private Contract. Make a set of tungsten drill bits and deliver them to the <Place> on <Planet>. Payment on contract completion."

LEVEL AND DISTANCE 2026-11-11 (his: 'some quests shouldnt be given to a level 1 player' and 'not sending them across the whole map just to deliver a coffee'; Eliza's minLevel and place.parsecs, FrankyCLI 3c81f6a): minLevel 35: pinned to Bolivar I, a level-35 system.

OT-32, 2026-11-13 (his 11-12 'our ore missions don't seem to work on missonboards, changed them to remote', and ore1 played 11:48 'yup that worked'): a REMOTE Delve now, ore1's shape. POOL: the slate's remote-planet node (duo_MS_ArtifactMap_RemotePlanetNode), on its test node until he plays it: the job is pinned to a planet elsewhere, which is what that pool deals. FAMILY: Requisition (old MB02 to 04), on the closed list. No card (a slate has none) and no minLevel (board only); parsecs 50, as ore1.
The call opened 'Those the bits?', the carried-thing opener he caught 11-13; it opens on the job now.
